t: The Lutec Chimera is a robust outdoor LED twin head floodlight, providing powerful and adjustable illumination for exterior spaces. This durable floodlight is ideal for those needing reliable lighting for building exteriors, workshops, or site security. Its dual adjustable LED heads deliver a bright 2350 lumens of 5000K daylight white light, ensuring excellent visibility. Constructed from tough, corrosion-resistant black polycarbonate, it offers long-lasting performance. An IP54 rating ensures protection against dust and water splashes, making it suitable for all outdoor conditions. Fixings are supplied for straightforward wall-mounted installation.
b: Easy Wall-Mounted Installation for Secure & Stable Fixing
